title: When gRPC beats REST and when it does not

videos.script: boxoffice now answers in two styles. This lesson asks when each one is the right door. {{table}} First a comparison, row by row: contract, size, browsers, tools, streams, errors, caching. {{bytes}} Then a measurement. Two hundred events are less than half the size in protobuf. Compressed, the difference is six per cent. {{debug}} Then debugging. curl cannot read a gRPC port, so grpcurl does it, and every gRPC error turns out to be an HTTP 200. {{browser}} Browsers cannot call gRPC without a translator, and strangers start with curl. {{both}} boxoffice serves both through two thin adapters over one store. {{decide}} And four questions decide, caller by caller.
